Ціль 14. Збереження морських ресурсів Завдання 14.1: Скоротити забруднення морського середовища Індикатор 14.1.1. Coverage: Державна служба статистики України. The publisher named on the listing is Державна служба статистики України. Its keywords include атрибути, дані, збереження, коди, морські, період. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX, JSON. The listing shows 2024-11-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
